summary: Depot loading-rate limits (soft). Ineffective with max_depot_runs or relations.
range: Object: { handling_duration?, max_vehicles?, vehicle_penalty?, max_load?, load_penalty? }.
constraints: Ineffective when max_depot_runs or relations is used.
businessRules: max_vehicles needs vehicle_penalty; max_load needs load_penalty — both soft.

throughput defines: An object to collect the details about depot's throughput - speed of loading orders into vehicle. Please note that throughput attributes are ineffective when either of max_depot_runs and relations …
Must stay consistent with: depots.throughput.max_vehicles, vehicles.max_depot_runs. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Relations define hard sequencing: job pairs, duration bounds, vehicle affinity.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: throughput limiting concurrent vehicles at a depot.
Interaction: with max_depot_runs set, throughput has no effect.
Interaction: Interaction: with a relation set, raising visit_lateness_penalty has no effect.
Interaction: Infeasible: an in_direct_sequence relation whose ordering is impossible -> all its tasks unassigned.
